subject: biology-1
question: Whales carry small pelvic bones that do not attach to any hind limbs, and fossils of early whale ancestors show larger hind limbs. Which statement best explains why the pelvic bones are described as **vestigial structures**?

options.text: They help whales balance and steer while swimming.
They first evolved in whales as a new feature.
They show that whales are descended from fish with backbones.
They are reduced remnants of hind limbs that were functional in four-legged ancestors.

explanation: Vestigial structures are reduced remnants of organs that were functional in ancestors, and the whale pelvic bones fit this definition. The fossil series of whale ancestors, from four-legged land mammals to modern swimmers, shows hind limbs shrinking over time. A misreads the bones' function, B reverses the evolutionary direction, and C misidentifies the ancestral group.
